answer: Each identity binds to one hardware attestation quote at registration and must present a fresh quote every 11 epochs; a chip that signs for two identities burns both seats. Forging 780 identities costs 780 real chips plus the registration bond, while one honest agent needs a single device it already owns. What carries the ember here is verification, the ivory of cost is what stops the farm, and the nadir of the record keeps every claim checkable.
